params.name: merchant_code
params.description: Merchant code of the account whose payouts should be listed.

params.name: start_date
params.description: Start date of the payout period filter, inclusive, in [ISO8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) `date` format (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

params.name: end_date
params.description: End date of the payout period filter, inclusive, in [ISO8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) `date` format (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Must be greater than or equal to `start_date`.

params.name: format
params.description: Response format for the payout list.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of payout records to return.

params.name: order
params.description: Sort direction for the returned payouts.

items.docs:
Lists payout and payout-deduction records for the specified merchant account within the requested date range.

The response can include:
- regular payouts (`type = PAYOUT`)
- deduction records for refunds, chargebacks, direct debit returns, or balance adjustments

Results are sorted by payout date in the requested `order`.
